defects.name: evaluate_cells counts an infinite score against an infinite threshold as a hit
defects.consequence: A case whose first acceptable rank never appears (score=inf) is reported as covered when the cell threshold is inf, inflating empirical coverage to 1.0.
defects.falsifier: Fix by excluding non-finite scores/thresholds (e.g. require math.isfinite(t) and math.isfinite(s)) and re-run; this check then reports NOT_FOUND.

defects.name: evaluate_cells silently substitutes math.inf for cells missing from calibration
defects.consequence: A cell that was never calibrated is scored with an infinite threshold, so every test case counts as covered instead of the cell being flagged uncalibrated/no_guarantee.
defects.falsifier: Fix by rejecting unknown cells (e.g. skip or raise) and re-run; this check then reports NOT_FOUND.

defects.name: stratified_sample can return fewer than n_total without raising

evidence.text: alloc = {s: max(min_per_stratum, round(n_total * len(v) / total)) for s, v in strata.items()}

defects.consequence: The only guard is k*min_per_stratum > n_total. Allocation uses max(min_per_stratum, ...), then m = min(alloc, len(stratum)) truncates silently, so a small stratum makes the returned sample shorter than requested.
defects.falsifier: Fix by raising when sum(m) != n_total, or by redistributing the shortfall, and re-run; `m = alloc[s]` (no silent truncation) makes this check report NOT_FOUND.

defects.name: blinded_pool keeps only the last rank of a repeated candidate

evidence.text: for rank, cand in enumerate(lst, start=1):

defects.consequence: Assigning key[...][arm] = rank inside the enumerate loop means a candidate listed twice in one arm overwrites its earlier rank; the first/best rank is lost from the private key.
defects.falsifier: Fix with setdefault (preserve first) or explicit duplicate rejection and re-run; this check then reports NOT_FOUND.

defects.name: _synthetic_scores has no M bound and can emit ranks beyond any pool size
defects.consequence: The generator draws geometric ranks with no upper bound, so the synthetic self-test exercises ranks that a bounded-M candidate pool cannot produce.
defects.falsifier: Fix by adding an M bound/truncation and re-run; a signature carrying an M parameter makes this check report NOT_FOUND.

defects.name: scoreboard reads `Status` while the canonical register column is `Evidence_status`
defects.consequence: Applied to a real register row the scoreboard raises KeyError; applied to a converted row it silently scores a different field, so its count is not a register count.
defects.falsifier: Fix by reading Evidence_status (or accepting both) and re-run; this check reports NOT_FOUND when the register header itself uses Status.

defects.name: blinded_pool collapses distinct surface forms to one normalized candidate
defects.consequence: `cand.strip().lower()` merges candidates that differ only by case/whitespace, so the rater pool silently loses alternatives and the private key retains one rank set.
defects.falsifier: Fix by keeping an explicit surface-form -> normalized map and re-run; this check reports NOT_FOUND if normalization is removed.

defects.name: degenerate agreement yields NaN kappa and an empty bootstrap without an explicit status

evidence.text: return cohen_kappa(a, b), float("nan"), float("nan"), len(vals)

defects.consequence: When pe == 1.0 cohen_kappa returns NaN; the bootstrap filters those resamples and falls back to (NaN, NaN, NaN, 0), which a downstream consumer can mistake for a measurement.
defects.falsifier: Fix by returning an explicit `undefined` status and re-run; this check reports NOT_FOUND if NaN is surfaced as a status instead of a float.

defects.name: conformal_threshold accepts alpha outside (0, 1) without validation
defects.consequence: alpha <= 0 yields k > n (infinite threshold); alpha >= 1 yields k <= 0 and a QoI-1 order statistic, i.e. a silent 100% coverage claim instead of an invalid-parameter error.
defects.falsifier: Fix by validating 0 < alpha < 1 and re-run; this check reports NOT_FOUND.
